name: agent
description: Start a coding-agent session in a directory, optionally with a task, resuming a previous session, with a model, or as a split

dir.description: the directory, as the request names it

prompt.description: the task text, exactly as written

resume.description: the session id or title to resume

name: wait
description: Wait until a coding session is idle (its turn finished) or waiting (it asks something)

session.description: 'it' for the session just launched, else agent@dir

name: tell
description: Send a message to a coding session and submit it

session.description: 'it' for the session just launched, else agent@dir

wait.description: wait until it is idle first
